description: Get the current 6-digit LinkedIn authenticator code for a client from their BAMF Vault key, so nobody relays PINs. Agency owner/admin only; API keys need the client_access:totp scope (posts:read is not enough). Rate-limited. A reason is required and every code is logged (who, when, why). Never returns the setup key.

client.description: Client workspace id, slug, or client name.

reason.description: Why the code is needed, e.g. 'LinkedIn sign-in on BAMF Cloud for the client's Multilogin profile'.

name: bamf.get_client_totp_code
